notes:
- PROFILE: Mid-tier enterprise health analytics vendor, strong privacy needs (PHI-adjacent), primary products: clinician search, claims summarization, triage chat.
- BUSINESS CASE: Targeting 99.95% uptime for inference, 95th pct latency SLO for chat <= 250ms (tokens streaming), throughput baseline 150 concurrent sessions with bursts to 400.
- POC SUMMARY (hosted -> dedicated evaluation): ran 2-week hosted POC using gpt-like open models; functional quality OK but unit cost + tail latency unacceptable under peak load.
- DEDICATED REQUIREMENTS DISCUSSED: reserved GPU pool sizing, pre-warmed KV caches, model pinning and fallback routing to smaller quantized variant. Preliminary sizing: 6x A100-40GB equiv for steady state, + 2x burst nodes; exploring 4x H100 equiv for 32k context experiments.
- MODEL-SPECIFIC TUNING: needs 32k context support for long patient notes (some sessions up to 25k tokens). Asking for recommended quantization profiles (int8 vs q4m/q5) for Llama2-70B-style models with minimal quality regression. SE asked for benchmark matrix: latency (p50/p95/p99), tokens/sec, NV memory usage across quant profiles.
- BATCHING & KV CACHE: major ask is per-customer sticky KV cache to reduce repeated prefix recompute; target: 3-5x token cost reduction for follow-up exchanges. Also request guidance on batching windows that keep 95th pct latency under SLO.
- SLA/CONTRACT POINTS: want explicit throughput guarantees (tokens/sec/node) and credits for tail latency breaches; insist on regional residency (us-east-2) + SOC2/ISO required. Procurement prefers 24-month reserved commit with 2:1 burst allowance.
- SECURITY/COMPLIANCE: will require KMS integration + HSM option for key custody, ability to ingest data into private VPC, audit logs retention 5 years for traceability.
- RECENT ACTIVITY: 10/21 discovery call (ff_2024-10-21_8342) w/ Head of AI + SecOps; 10/30 tech deep dive with infra (ff_2024-10-30_1209) - ran initial perf microbenchmarks. 11/01 we delivered first draft of sizing + cost model. 11/02 SE follow-up: requested quantization benchmark plan and sample A/B eval prompt set.
- QUOTES/NOTES FROM CUSTOMER: "We need predictable tail latency more than raw peak throughput — outages or spikes kill clinician trust." "If you can show 2x cost reduction via caching + quant tuning and guarantee latency, procurement moves fast."
- NEXT STEPS (short): Draft SLA with throughput commitments; schedule infra-sizing call 2024-11-07; run quantization matrix on customer prompt set (SE to run with infra team), provide canary rollout plan for model pinning and automatic fallback.
- STAGE RISK: medium-high — technical feasibility for 32k context at target latency is the key risk. Procurement timeline driven by security pen-test scheduling.
